rule: Only published/direct empirical measurements or official observation products may enter evidence calculations.
mixed_paper_rule: If a source contains observations and simulations/models, only explicitly transcribed measured quantities may enter MESURES_EMPIRIQUES.csv; modeled quantities are listed in portion_excluded.
negative_rule: Missing empirical information remains missing; it is never imputed.
C_AST_firewall: C-AST-01 remains a separate model-level certification and is not counted as empirical genealogy evidence.
